# Alexis de Lécluse

> Personal portfolio of Alexis de Lécluse, engineering student at ENSEEIHT (Toulouse INP, France), specialising in embedded AI and computer vision. Available in English and French.

## Pages

- [Portfolio (English)](https://alexisdelecluse.fr/): projects, skills, internships, international mobility, civic engagement, activities and contact
- [Portfolio (French)](https://alexisdelecluse.fr/index-fr.html): French version of the same content

## Selected projects

- Aeris: decision-support tool for coordinating drone deployments, 2nd place at the AGIR hackathon (2026). Source: https://github.com/Tug2co/aeris
- Laser-guided drone defense system: ongoing computer vision study (detection and tracking) through N7 Consulting
- TrackMyApps: SaaS to track internship and job applications, with an AI interview simulator. Live: https://track-my-apps.alexisdelecluse.fr/ Source: https://github.com/A2Lec/TrackMyApps
- Financial prediction model: stock index forecasting with Random Forest and XGBoost
- Solar tracker: two-axis Arduino solar tracker
